title: (No AI) What’s really at stake in the Jensen Huang saga
author: David Pierce
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/VRG_VST_111326_Site.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

One part of [the saga surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1030422/nvidia-jensen-huang-ai-china-alice-huang) ended on Thursday, when [Huang resigned](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1031689/jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-resigns) from his position at the top of AI's most important company. But in the coming weeks and months, [a much bigger story](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1032069/jensen-huang-resignation-affair-chips-smuggling) may be about to unfold. A story about Nvidia's dealings in China, about the US government's willingness to turn a lot of blind eyes to protect a powerful ally, and about the very stability of the AI industry as a whole. It's a lot.

On [this episode of _The Vergecast_](https://pod.link/vergecast), David and Nilay start by trying to unpack the many parts of the story. We're all going to learn a lot more about Megaspeed than we ever planned or wanted, and we're goin …

title: (No AI) Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful
author: Allison Johnson
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/DSC04398_processed.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Let’s get to work. | Photo: Allison Johnson / The Verge

Normally, the products I test don't offer to help me write up my experience with them. Duet is different.

Claude Duet is Anthropic's AI agent for consumers, the latest attempt by an AI company to try to convince us that agents can be useful for people who don't write code. It's been an interesting couple of months: Instinct gave us [an impressive text-based assistant](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1008254/instinct-agent-ai-hands-on-muse-dots), Meta offered us its cute little guy, Muse, [to help us buy things](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/999526/meta-muse-ai-agent-hands-on-shopping), and OpenAI gave us [the more work-oriented Dots](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004096/openai-chatgpt-dots-hands-on-agent). Claude Duet is even more focused on work than those. It's also more consumer-friendly than [Claude Cowork](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1030709/anthropic-has-its-own-ai-powered-office-suite-now), which was more consumer-friendly than Claude Code - the co …
